name: Strategy 12
description: Strategy 10 with stop and reverse: when a position's initial stop (1R) is hit, the opposite position opens at the stop fill (a full new 3-lot position: stop 1R on the other side, lot 1 out at 1R, lot 2 at 2R, the rest trails from 3R); once per signal, not after a trail stop, not at or after the square-off. Options via futures: a stopped leg reverses into the opposite signal's leg (long CE -> long PE, short PE -> short CE), strike from the index at the stop. Standalone options: the same option, other side. Entries: Strategy 2's.
